#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FFT {
    static void fft(std::vector<double>& a, std::vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = a.size();
        int shift = 32 - (int)std::floor(std::log2(n));
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (int)std::reverse(i << shift);
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(a[i], a[j]);
                std::swap(b[i], b[j]);
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            std::vector<double> cs(halfLen), sn(halfLen);
            for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
                cs[i] = cos(angle);
                sn[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                    double wA = cs[j];
                    double wB = sn[j];
                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];
                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

std::vector<int> multiplyMod(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = std::max(2, (int)std::bit_ceil(need));
    std::vector<double> aReal(n), aImaginary(n), bReal(n), bImaginary(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        aImaginary[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }
    for (int i = (int)a.size(); i < n; i++) {
        aReal[i] = 0;
        aImaginary[i] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        bImaginary[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }
    for (int i = (int)b.size(); i < n; i++) {
        bReal[i] = 0;
        bImaginary[i] = 0;
    }

    FFT::fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);
    FFT::fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

    std::vector<double> faReal(n), faImaginary(n), fbReal(n), fbImaginary(n);
    for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        int j = ((n - i) & (n -1));
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2.0;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2.0;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2.0;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2.0;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    FFT::fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
    FFT::fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);

    std::vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = (aa + (bb % mod) << 15 + (cc % mod) << 30) % mod;
        res[i] = (int)val;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int mod = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;

    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
        if (p == 0) break;
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    cout << res << "\n";

    return 0;
}
